name: Lisa Gonzalez Moore

items.text: In October 2026, The Bradenton Times reported that the Christian Family Coalition Manatee PAC texted Democratic and unaffiliated Bradenton voters calling her "MAGA to her CORE". The PAC had also backed her opponent. Gonzalez Moore said she never spoke with the PAC and called it an attempt to mislead voters.
items.why: The item describes outside groups targeting her, not conduct by her, so it has no bearing on any criterion.

for_review: I read the Mitch Maley opinion column and the Dawn Kitterman news report. The report covers Christian Family Coalition Manatee PAC and Floridians for Public Safety PC. I didn't find or read anything on America Only PAC, so that part of the item is unverified. The report cut off before its end. The one combined search naming the owner's four sites returned nothing from them about this candidate. Voters may want to know the Bradenton Times endorsed her, so its coverage is not neutral. The PAC finding doesn't allege any misconduct by her.
